name: DrillSample
summary: Two-step selection for dense handheld AR: a ray drills through the scene, then the hit objects are laid out for picking.
howItWorks: The user taps to cast a ray from the touch point; all objects along it are collected and shown separately so the intended one, even if hidden, can be chosen.
